title: ATS Resume Screening — Candidate Vigilance
description: Cross-domain ATS resume screening tools: format compliance checking, keyword match scoring, experience relevance analysis, gap detection, and pass/fail recommendation. Vigilance applied to hiring — same signal detection principles, different boundary.

tools.name: screen-resume
tools.description: Run the full ATS resume screening chain: format compliance → experience relevance → keyword match → gap detection → recommendation. Returns overall verdict (STRONG_MATCH, CONDITIONAL_MATCH, WEAK_MATCH, REJECT, RECONSIDER), pass probability, and prioritized fix list.

parameters.name: file_type_compatible
parameters.description: Whether the resume file type is ATS-compatible (.docx, .pdf)

parameters.name: has_standard_headers
parameters.description: Whether standard section headers exist (Experience, Education, Skills)

parameters.name: uses_simple_formatting
parameters.description: Whether formatting is ATS-parseable (no tables, columns, text boxes)

parameters.name: has_contact_info
parameters.description: Whether contact info (name, email, phone) is in plain text at top

parameters.name: sections_detected
parameters.description: Number of distinct sections detected in the resume

parameters.name: matched_keywords
parameters.description: Number of job description keywords found in resume

parameters.name: total_keywords
parameters.description: Total keywords extracted from job description

parameters.name: direct_experience_years
parameters.description: Years of directly relevant experience

parameters.name: transferable_experience_years
parameters.description: Years of transferable experience from adjacent roles

parameters.name: required_years
parameters.description: Years of experience required by job listing

parameters.name: missing_hard_skills
parameters.description: Count of required hard skills not found in resume

parameters.name: missing_credentials
parameters.description: Count of required credentials/certifications not held

final_output.description: Accumulated screening results with overall_verdict, pass_probability, priority_fixes, format_verdict, match_tier, gap_severity, relevance_tier

steps.description: Per-step decision trace through all 5 screening stages

tools.name: check-format
tools.description: Check resume format for ATS parser compatibility. Evaluates file type, section headers, formatting complexity, contact info placement, and section count. Returns format_score (0-100) and parseable boolean.

parameters.name: file_type_compatible
parameters.description: Whether the file type is ATS-compatible (.docx, .pdf)

parameters.name: has_standard_headers
parameters.description: Whether standard section headers exist

parameters.name: uses_simple_formatting
parameters.description: Whether formatting is single-column, no tables/text boxes

parameters.name: has_contact_info
parameters.description: Whether contact info is in plain text at top

parameters.name: sections_detected
parameters.description: Number of distinct sections detected

tools.name: score-keywords
tools.description: Score keyword overlap between resume content and job description requirements. Returns match tier (STRONG/MODERATE/WEAK) and ATS pass likelihood.

parameters.name: matched_keywords
parameters.description: Number of job description keywords found in resume

parameters.name: total_keywords
parameters.description: Total keywords extracted from job description

tools.name: detect-gaps
tools.description: Detect critical gaps between resume and job requirements — missing skills, experience shortfalls, credential gaps. Returns severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MODERATE/LOW/NONE) and whether gaps are fixable via resume optimization.

parameters.name: missing_hard_skills
parameters.description: Count of required hard skills not found in resume

parameters.name: missing_soft_skills
parameters.description: Count of required soft skills not demonstrated

parameters.name: missing_credentials
parameters.description: Count of required credentials not held

parameters.name: years_experience_gap
parameters.description: Years below the required experience level

tools.name: assess-experience
tools.description: Score how relevant listed experience is to the target role. Classifies as HIGH (direct), MODERATE, TRANSFERABLE, or LOW. Provides reframing advice for career changers.

parameters.name: direct_experience_years
parameters.description: Years of directly relevant experience

parameters.name: transferable_experience_years
parameters.description: Years of transferable experience from adjacent roles

parameters.name: unrelated_experience_years
parameters.description: Years of unrelated experience

parameters.name: required_years
parameters.description: Years of experience required by the position
